title: Do Corporate Governance Analysts Matter? Evidence from the Expansion of Governance Analyst Coverage

scopes.description: Complete supplied NL_code.do preparation workflow and its Table 1 sample-description and Table 2 analyses. The scope includes all six direct prepared-file reads and every generated Master/EM2 stage. Appendix-only analyses without supplied code (including the separate ISS proxy-voting table) are not independent targets.

requirements.description: Author-prepared joint TR_data.dta input consumed as one Stata panel. It must combine Worldscope accounting/identity fields, Datastream financial and market fields, and ASSET4 score fields named in NL_code.do (including wc05350, wc06001, wc06008, wc07536, wc07021, wc05661, wc03251, wc02501, wc02999, dwta, dwse, wc03501, wc01001, wc04001, wc04860, wc05101, wc05001, mv, nosh, noshff, cgvscore). The code expects a dot-delimited fiscal-year-end string, forms calendar year, and documents a UK panel for 2001–2009. Keep the full documented panel because year_1…year_9 indexing, whole-panel winsorization and PCA/sample construction precede the 2003–2007 balanced sample and 2004–2006 Table 2. The code also uses a one-year sales lag; do not extend earlier than the documented panel solely on that basis. The joined schema, field types/units, supplier joins and period coverage are not available for inspection.

issues.description: The frozen package supplies the Stata do-file, documentation, online appendix and NL_identifiers.dta, but not the six direct files read by NL_code.do. The author documentation identifies upstream providers and some timing/definitions, yet does not provide exact schemas, current authorized access, and complete field/year coverage for the prepared TR_data, ISS, mixed IBES/stock, TRAA, ISS/FTSE and hand-collected GOV inputs. Confirm the author-prepared file manifest and route; the historical ISS/RMG/FTSE agreements do not prove a current access barrier.

NL_code.do creates year dummies from the observed sorted year values, then hardcodes year_1, year_2 and year_8/year_9 as the outside years and year_3–year_7 as 2003–2007. The code comment describes a 2001–2009 TR_data panel, but the input is absent; missing or extra year categories would shift the dummy positions and alter the sample/treatment definitions. Confirm the complete nine-year input year sequence and that all firm-year inputs use the same fiscal-year-end calendar year key. No extra 2000 requirement is inferred solely from the one-year lag.

The supplied Table 2 writes to the same placeholder file, Platzhalter.rtf. Panel A begins with replace and appends its remaining results; Panels B and C each use replace, so the final file contains only Panel C. This behavior is established by the supplied code. Retaining all three panels can be handled during ordinary output preparation by routing each panel’s existing writes to a separate local RTF in a working copy; if retaining only the final Panel C output is sufficient, the supplied behavior can remain. No author confirmation is needed to choose local output names, and no analysis or scientific definition changes are indicated.

evidence.description: The supplied Stata program describes its Table 2 scope and categories of commercial, proprietary and hand-collected inputs.
evidence.quote:
*
*	The Stata do-file uses all nine datasets (see "NL_data description") as inputs and provides a detailed step-by-step description that enables other researchers to arrive at the same dataset used in my study. 
*	In addition, it shows the Stata code for the main empirical analysis presented in Table 2 of the paper.
*	The analysis is based on three different data source types:
*		(1) commercially available data (i.e., Datastream, Worldscope, IBES, TRAA),
*		(2) proprietary data (ISS coverage data, FTSE/ISS index membership data),
*		(3) publically available data (handcolleted governance data from annual reports).
